name: Villa Lena Foundation Artist Residency

eligibility.eligibility_notes: Open to artists of all backgrounds and nationalities and at all stages of their careers. All creative disciplines.

funding.stipend_detail: No stipend. Fee-based: the artist pays. One scholarship a year waives the fee but pays no cash. Partner-sponsored places exist with unpublished terms.
artist_pays: residency fee, EUR 150/week per TransArtists or EUR 20/day per Villa Lena's own pages

deadline_notes: Closed. Villa Lena's Open Calls page says applications for the 2027 programme are closed. Past cycles closed around late May to early June.
duration: 4 to 5 week group residencies, April to October
money_summary: No stipend. Artist pays a weekly or daily fee plus a EUR 21 application fee
notes: Pay-to-attend. Studios up to 120 m2 and ceramics facilities, but fails the stipend requirement. Official site could not be loaded directly; facts come from its search-indexed text corroborated by TransArtists.
curation_note: Condensed 2026-09-10 from the Italy research agent output.

name: Marea Art Project

eligibility.eligibility_notes: 2026 call: artist must be legally resident in a Creative Europe participating country other than Italy. Legal residence counts, not nationality, and India is not on the list. Outside calls, participation is by invitation.

funding.stipend_detail: No stipend from Marea's own funds. Marea only provides a letter of support for the artist's own EU Culture Moves Europe grant, which is open to Creative Europe residents only. Otherwise the artist must bring their own funding.
artist_pays: own funding outside an EU-funded call

discipline.thematic_constraint: Research or production in dialogue with the cultural, social and anthropological context of the Amalfi Coast, Southern Italy and the Mediterranean.

deadline_notes: Closed. Expression of interest was due 22 March 2026, then the artist's own EU grant application by 30 April 2026.
money_summary: No stipend from Marea. Only paid route is an EU travel grant closed to India residents
notes: Blocked twice: residence rule and no own funding. Historic houses with many stairs as workspaces, a weak practical fit for sculpture or vitrines.
curation_note: Condensed 2026-09-10 from the Italy research agent output.

name: Arroscia Residency
location: Pieve di Teco, Arroscia Valley, Liguria

eligibility.eligibility_notes: Open to artists based anywhere in the world. Open to emerging and mid-career artists. Must apply and be accepted individually. Not for artists enrolled in an academic program. Disciplines: painting, drawing, collage, fiber art, photography, murals, installations and mixed media work.

funding.stipend_detail: EUR 300 per week for art supplies and living expenses, plus paid housing and round-trip flights from the artist's hometown airport to Europe, reimbursed on arrival. No residency fees.
funding.materials_budget: No separate budget; the weekly stipend covers art supplies and living expenses
artist_pays: food and daily living beyond the EUR 300/week stipend
one jury-chosen artwork donated to the permanent collection

discipline.thematic_constraint: None. Output of at least 6 to 8 pieces exhibited in the studio.

deadline_notes: Closed. Fall 2026 call ran 3 March to 7 April 2026 (TheArtList says 5 April). No Spring 2027 call published as of 2026-09-10. Calls run twice a year.
money_summary: EUR 300/week stipend, free housing, return flights reimbursed on arrival
style_fit_reason: Self-directed with no theme and names installation and mixed media, but facilities are painting-oriented and a 6 to 8 piece minimum is heavy for sculptural work.
cautions: Last call closed 7 April 2026. No Spring 2027 call is published yet, so watch for it.
Airfare is paid up front and only reimbursed on arrival.
Facilities are painting-oriented. No sculpture, wood or metal workshop is mentioned.
Must produce at least 6 to 8 pieces, and one jury-chosen piece stays in the permanent collection.
Very selective: 3 artists from 76 applicants in the latest year.
The official site could not be loaded directly. Facts come from its indexed text and directory listings, so confirm before applying.
notes: The only one of the three Italian residencies that pays the artist. Studio in a renovated medieval palazzo, run by a Texas-based nonprofit founded 2023. Housing is described as private by one directory and shared by another.
